text:
Maya: FYI — EduChannel reseller cutover next billing period (May invoice). Need to confirm prorate logic + marketplace SKU mapping for AWS and Azure. @Liam @Arjun can you confirm? Also need whether we push credits for onboarding. Thanks.

Liam: Do we have the cutover schedule? who owns the mapping?

Maya: Cutover date 2024-05-01. Partner will be switched to new SKU IDs. I think Sales provided mapping in the spreadsheet but finance needs to update charging rules.

Arjun: Uploaded draft mapping here: https://drive.redwood/invoices/edu-reseller-mapping-v1.xlsx — sample lines attached below
```
partner_sku,old_marketplace_sku,new_marketplace_sku,prorate_window_days
EDU_BASIC,aws-edu-001,aws-edu-2024-05,30
EDU_PRO,aws-edu-002,aws-edu-2024-05,30
```
We need to decide if prorate based on activation date or usage days.

Sasha: For GL: use revenue bucket 'edureseller_revenue' and contra account 'partner_promo'. Also confirm tax handling — partner is VAT registered? @Maya

Maya: Partner gave VAT ID on 2024-04-15. So VAT reverse charge applies for EU/MRCs. For US it's sales tax per state. Could we get checklist for per-region rules?

Liam: I can prepare per-region checklist. quick Q: what about credits for onboarding — 1000 free seats promo? Are credits applied as invoice line items or off-invoice credit notes?

Arjun: Prefer issuing negative invoice lines (promo lines) so we keep one invoice per period. Example CSV snippet:
```
date,customer_id,sku,qty,unit_price,total,notes
2024-05-01,CUST-123,aws-edu-2024-05,100,0.00,0.00,onboarding promo -1000 seats
```
But Marketplace APIs sometimes block zero-dollar lines; may need credit note flow.

finance-bot: Ticket created FIN-8427: 'EduChannel cutover: confirm proration & promo handling' assigned to @Liam. https://issues.redwood/FIN-8427

Maya: thx. Liam, can you confirm by EOD Thursday? We need to sync with billing system (Zuora) by Friday.

Liam: On it. I'll post the checklist and validate if Zuora allows zero-dollar lines with marketplace connector. ETA Thu EOD.

Sasha: Also flagging that channel partner settlement reports will require new mapping — ops needs export keys updated. I've pinged eng-ops.

Arjun: If Zuora can't do promo lines, we'll do credit notes. That means partner will see two documents. Not ideal for partners but okay.

Maya: OK capture both paths in the doc. let's meet Friday 10am to finalize. Calendar invite sent.
